brimstone_tammy_head.effect: Burst of 10 Brimstone tears in all directions
brimstone_tammy_head.details: When activating Tammy's Head, fires 10 Brimstone beams in all directions. Clears entire rooms.

ipecac_my_reflection.effect: Massive explosions that return to enemies
ipecac_my_reflection.details: Poison tears return and explode near enemies. Watch out for self-damage.

tech_x_brimstone.details: Combines Tech X ring with Brimstone beam. Massive area damage.

sacred_heart_godhead.effect: Massive damage with sacred aura + homing
sacred_heart_godhead.details: Sacred Heart gives homing and +1 damage, Godhead adds damage aura. Ultimate combo.

crickets_head_polyphemus.details: Damage multipliers stack. One shot kills practically everything.

technology_spoon_bender.details: Technology laser gains homing. Perfect auto-aim.

mom_knife_dead_eye.details: Dead Eye maintains multiplier since the knife always hits.

tiny_planet_rubber_cement.details: Tears orbit and bounce. Excellent coverage in closed rooms.

the_ludovico_technique_strange_attractor.details: Control the tear while enemies are attracted to it.

dr_fetus_ipecac.effect: ⚠️ Bombs explode on fire, self-damage almost guaranteed
dr_fetus_ipecac.details: DANGEROUS: Bombs become unstable. High chance of self-damage.

soy_milk_polyphemus.details: Soy Milk drastically reduces Polyphemus damage. Not worth it.

brimstone_chocolate_milk.effect: ⚠️ Extra charge doesn't add much to Brimstone
brimstone_chocolate_milk.details: Chocolate Milk doesn't significantly benefit Brimstone.

brimstone_polyphemus.details: Polyphemus damage applies multiplicatively to Brimstone beam

brimstone_monstros_lung.details: After a long charge, fires multiple Brimstone beams in a wide spread, covering nearly the entire room. One of the strongest Brimstone synergies.

brimstone_ludovico_technique.details: The Ludovico-controlled tear becomes a Brimstone ring that orbits Isaac, dealing continuous laser damage to every enemy it touches.

brimstone_inner_eye.details: Fires three Brimstone beams at once in a spread pattern, tripling coverage and damage output.

brimstone_mutant_spider.details: Fires four Brimstone beams simultaneously. Fire rate penalty from Mutant Spider is irrelevant for a charge weapon.

brimstone_jacobs_ladder.effect: Electric arcs jump from the beam to nearby enemies
brimstone_jacobs_ladder.details: Jacob's Ladder adds electric arcs to the Brimstone beam, extending its effective damage range sideways.

brimstone_continuum.effect: Beam wraps around the entire screen
brimstone_continuum.details: The Brimstone beam extends through walls and re-enters from the opposite side, hitting enemies from both directions at once.

brimstone_flat_stone.details: Flat Stone makes the laser ricochet off walls and obstacles, allowing it to reach enemies around corners. Repentance only.

brimstone_haemolacria.effect: Beam impact spawns blood ball burst
brimstone_haemolacria.details: The Brimstone laser fires normally but triggers a Haemolacria blood ball burst on impact, adding area-of-effect damage. Repentance only.

brimstone_godhead.effect: Godhead damage aura surrounds the beam
brimstone_godhead.details: Godhead's damage aura travels alongside the Brimstone beam, dealing extra tick damage to every enemy the beam passes near.

brimstone_deaths_touch.effect: Wider beam with extra flat damage
brimstone_deaths_touch.details: Death's Touch visually widens the Brimstone beam and contributes its +1.5 flat damage bonus to each tick.

brimstone_eye_of_the_occult.effect: Steer the Brimstone beam in real time
brimstone_eye_of_the_occult.details: Eye of the Occult gives full directional control of your shot. Combined with Brimstone, you can freely steer the laser to track any moving enemy.

ipecac_ludovico_technique.effect: Controlled Ipecac orb — constant explosion damage
ipecac_ludovico_technique.details: The Ludovico tear becomes an Ipecac orb that continuously applies poison explosion damage to any enemy it overlaps. Extremely lethal.

mom_knife_mutant_spider.details: Fires four Mom's Knife projectiles in a spread. Each knife deals full damage, dramatically multiplying total output per throw.

mom_knife_ludovico_technique.details: The Ludovico tear is replaced by a floating knife that can be repositioned over enemies, dealing continuous Mom's Knife contact damage.

epic_fetus_mom_knife.effect: Knife launched as a guided missile
epic_fetus_mom_knife.details: The knife is fired like an Epic Fetus missile, homing toward the crosshair target and dealing high impact damage on arrival.

proptosis_sacred_heart.details: Proptosis tears deal maximum damage immediately on spawn. Sacred Heart's 2.3× multiplier and flat damage bonus amplify this to lethal levels.

polyphemus_sacred_heart.effect: Massive homing tear — one-shots almost everything
polyphemus_sacred_heart.details: Polyphemus's +2 damage stacks multiplicatively with Sacred Heart's 2.3× multiplier, producing a single homing tear with extraordinary damage.

epic_fetus_sacred_heart.effect: Sacred missiles — huge damage, reliable homing
epic_fetus_sacred_heart.details: Epic Fetus missiles inherit Sacred Heart's full damage multiplier and improved homing, making every missile a devastating guaranteed hit.

chocolate_milk_crown_of_light.effect: Charged shots doubled while at full health
chocolate_milk_crown_of_light.details: Crown of Light doubles damage at full health. Chocolate Milk's fully charged shots multiply that further, producing very high burst damage.

dr_fetus_monstros_lung.details: After a full charge, fires multiple bombs in the Monstro's Lung spread pattern, blanketing a wide area with simultaneous explosions.

dr_fetus_polyphemus.details: Polyphemus's +2 flat damage applies to Dr. Fetus bombs. The bomb rate is also reduced, but each explosion hits significantly harder.

dead_cat_judas_shadow.effect: Nine extra lives as Black Judas
dead_cat_judas_shadow.details: Dead Cat sets your heart containers to 1, making death frequent. Each death triggers Judas' Shadow's revival as Black Judas, effectively giving 9 lives.
